about.title: Waa'ee Koo
about.p1: Ani barataa Saayinsii Kompiitaraa kan fedhii guddaa qabu gara ijaarsa weebsaayitii, networking, fi cybersecurity. appilikeshiniiwan weebii ammayyaa kan UI/UX qulqulluu qaban ijaaruu fi rakkoo addunyaa dhugaa teeknooloojiidhaan furuu nan jaalladha.
about.p2: Amma dandeettii koo kan full-stack development fi cloud computing irratti babal'isaa jira. Hojiilee open-source irratti walii hojjachuu fi teeknooloojii haaraa barachuu nan jaalladha.
